inner_split: deterministic 90/10 gene holdout of 46618 train genes, seed 20261011 (inner-train 41956 / inner-val 4662 genes)
selection_rule: max inner-val gene E Spearman; per-candidate LR chosen independently from {0.001,0.0003}
epoch_rule_frozen: final model = train on FULL original 46618 train genes for 12 epochs (the predeclared max), selected LR per candidate, seed 20261011; final checkpoint (epoch 12) evaluated once on frozen val/test
epoch_rule_note: both candidates were still improving at the 12-epoch cap; no post-hoc epoch extension; possible headroom noted for a future batch
replication: seeds 20261012/20261013 for both candidates (matched); partial robustness is disclosed, not claimed as 3-seed robustness
comparison_design: rc1 single vs rc2 bag share the identical Trunk capacity; difference isolates scalar-mean inference vs embedding mean+max pooling
